title: Decide whether Remote Control connect stays open to non-loopback hosts
body:
## Summary
POST /api/ue5-bridge/query connect accepts any bare host, so the server will probe an arbitrary address.

## Description
src/app/api/ue5-bridge/query/route.ts validates the host shape only. The Blender bridge restricts connect to loopback, but src/stores/ue5BridgeStore.ts:82 exposes setHost, so a remote editor may be a supported setup. Whether it is decides the rule.

## Flow
- operator answers: is a non-loopback UE editor supported?
- if no: refuse non-loopback hosts as the Blender connect does
- if yes: leave as is and rely on requireOperator

## Expected impact
Closes server-side probing of other hosts; breaks anyone driving an editor on another machine.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - connect cannot reach off-machine addresses
Before: any bare host accepted after requireOperator
After: loopback only, if the operator confirms
Method: simulation - the deciding fact is product intent, not a figure
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
impact: Closes server-side probing of other hosts; breaks anyone driving an editor on another machine.

title: Verify inject-item against a live PIE session; created item is discarded
body:
## Summary
inject-item creates an item, ignores the result, then asks a hard-coded object path to add a second copy.

## Description
src/app/api/ue5-inject-item/route.ts:68 calls CreatePreRolledItem and uses createResult only for its ok flag; :83 passes the same definition again to ServerAddItemFromExternal at the literal path on :84. PIE world paths normally carry a UEDPIE prefix, so that path may never resolve. Tonight forbids contacting an editor, so neither claim could be checked.

## Flow
- run PIE with the bridge up (operator-only)
- POST a crafted item
- read whether the inventory gained one item, none, or an orphan instance

## Expected impact
The Affix Workbench inject button either works or is reporting a false failure or leak; one live run settles it.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - inject adds exactly one item in real PIE
Before: no live evidence; 2 editor calls per inject, first result unused
After: one observed inventory delta of +1
Method: simulation - a live editor is out of bounds for this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
impact: The Affix Workbench inject button either works or is reporting a false failure or leak; one live run settles it.
instrument: one manual or pof_ue_status-backed PIE run counting inventory items before and after

title: pof-mcp sends no operator token to the routes guarded tonight
body:
## Summary
With POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN set, pof_ue_compile and pof_ue_run_tests would now answer 401.

## Description
tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/ue.ts:187 and :207 post to compile and test. grep for OPERATOR in tools/pof-mcp/src returns nothing, so the MCP presents no token. Without a token configured (the local default) header-less calls pass requireOperator, so this only bites a token deployment; the same gap already exists for earlier guarded routes.

## Flow
- set POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN
- call pof_ue_compile
- observe 401
- make the MCP client send x-operator-token from the env

## Expected impact
MCP keeps working on a token deployment. Could break nothing when the token is unset.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - MCP works with a token configured
Before: 0 token references in tools/pof-mcp/src
After: token sent when the env var is set
Method: simulation - pof-mcp is outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: MCP keeps working on a token deployment. Could break nothing when the token is unset.
instrument: a pof-mcp client test asserting the header when POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN is set

title: Promote readJsonObject from blender-mcp into api-utils
body:
## Summary
Seven ue5-build-bridge routes now import a generic body reader from another feature's _lib folder.

## Description
src/app/api/blender-mcp/_lib/body.ts is route-agnostic. 64 route files under src/app/api contain the "must be a JSON object" message, mostly hand-rolled. api-utils belongs to ui-primitives, so moving it was out of this round.

## Flow
- move readJsonObject and MALFORMED_BODY_ERROR to @/lib/api-utils
- repoint importers
- adopt per file as routes are touched

## Expected impact
One reader and one message. Only import paths change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one shared body reader
Before: 64 files with the message; 1 shared helper in a feature folder
After: helper in api-utils, importers repointed
Method: probe - grep count on the real tree
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: grep -rl "must be a JSON object" src/app/api = 64 files
impact: One reader and one message. Only import paths change.
instrument: the same grep count plus typecheck

title: An unreachable PoF bridge answers 500; the sibling bridge answers 503
body:
## Summary
pofProxyError maps a dead editor to the default 500 while the ue5-bridge routes use 503.

## Description
src/lib/pof-bridge/proxy.ts:137 calls apiError(detail) with no status. src/app/api/ue5-bridge/query/route.ts:82 answers 503 for the same condition. A 500 reads as a PoF defect in logs and monitors. proxy.test.ts pins status 500 at :198.

## Flow
- change the unreachable branch to 503
- re-pin proxy.test.ts
- check clients that branch on status

## Expected impact
Monitors can tell a closed editor from a server bug.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - unreachable reads as unavailable
Before: 500 vs 503 for one condition
After: 503 on both
Method: simulation - the pinned test and clients sit outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: contract
impact: Monitors can tell a closed editor from a server bug.

title: ue-test-scaffold GET returns an unfiltered list for a mistyped tier
body:
## Summary
parseDrainFilter drops an unknown tier, so ?tier=L9 lists every planned test.

## Description
src/lib/test-gate-runner/drain.ts:52 keeps the tier only when parseTier accepts it, and the route treats the rest as no filter. The drain routes share this parser, so a typo there widens a batch rather than refusing it. Shared code, outside this context.

## Flow
- GET /api/ue-test-scaffold?tier=L9
- observe the full list
- report unknown tiers from the parser and answer 400 at each caller

## Expected impact
A typo stops widening the scope of a listing or drain.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - unknown tier refused
Before: unknown tier yields no filter
After: 400 naming the tier
Method: simulation - parser owned by the drain context
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: A typo stops widening the scope of a listing or drain.
instrument: route tests for drain and scaffold with tier=L9

title: Editor-mutating bridge actions leave no record
body:
## Summary
consoleCommand, setProperty, callFunction, hot-patch and inject log nothing about who ran what.

## Description
src/app/api/ue5-bridge/query/route.ts and the pof-bridge POST routes contain no logger or audit call on the success path. When an editor misbehaves after a session there is no trail of what the app sent it.

## Flow
- add one logger.info per mutating action with action and target, never values
- count lines in a stubbed run

## Expected impact
Post-incident reconstruction becomes possible. Log volume rises slightly.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every mutating action leaves one line
Before: 0 log calls on these success paths
After: 1 per action
Method: simulation - the useful detail level is an operator call
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: grep logger src/app/api/ue5-bridge/query/route.ts src/app/api/pof-bridge = 0 hits in route files
impact: Post-incident reconstruction becomes possible. Log volume rises slightly.
instrument: a stubbed-logger test counting one line per mutating action

title: No request-size ceiling on hot-patch and transpiler bodies
body:
## Summary
fileContent, blueprintJson and existingCpp are read whole with no cap.

## Description
src/app/api/blueprint-transpiler/route.ts parses and re-serializes the Blueprint up to three times per request, and hot-patch forwards fileContent as is. A local tool is unlikely to be fed a huge body by accident, so the benefit needs a figure first.

## Flow
- time and measure heap for a 50 MB blueprintJson
- only if it hurts: refuse above a measured ceiling

## Expected impact
Bounds worst-case memory. A ceiling set too low refuses a large real Blueprint.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - bounded memory per request
Before: unbounded, not measured
After: measured ceiling
Method: simulation - no measured large Blueprint in this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
impact: Bounds worst-case memory. A ceiling set too low refuses a large real Blueprint.
instrument: a timing and heap script over a synthetic large Blueprint

title: Decide the future of the hot-patch route, which no app code calls
body:
## Summary
POST /api/pof-bridge/compile/hot-patch has no caller in the app or pof-mcp.

## Description
grep for hot-patch outside tests finds only the route, src/lib/pof-bridge/routes.ts:53 and the types. It writes a source file into the UE tree and compiles, which is a large surface to keep unused. Tonight it was guarded, not removed.

## Flow
- operator: keep for a planned feature, or remove route and POF_ROUTES entry

## Expected impact
Removes an unused write surface or records why it stays. The plugin side would be unaffected.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no unused write route
Before: 0 callers (grep), 1 route
After: 0 routes or a named consumer
Method: probe - grep; whether it is planned is not in the tree
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
impact: Removes an unused write surface or records why it stays. The plugin side would be unaffected.

title: Status stream keepalive bypasses UI_TIMEOUTS
body:
## Summary
The 30 s SSE keepalive is a literal, against the UI_TIMEOUTS convention.

## Description
src/app/api/ue5-bridge/status/route.ts:55 hard-codes 30_000. src/lib/constants.ts is a shared file outside this context, so adding the key was left out.

## Flow
- add UI_TIMEOUTS.sseKeepalive
- use it here

## Expected impact
One place to tune keepalive. No behaviour change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - timing constant in one place
Before: 1 literal
After: 0 literals
Method: probe - grep
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: One place to tune keepalive. No behaviour change.
instrument: grep for the literal plus typecheck
